objective: Steal 10 pumpkins from the farm to the west, just north of Deathknell and take them to Apothecary Johaan in Brill.

description: What have we here?  You look like a fledgling <class>.  If you hope to prove yourself to The Dark Lady, you need to learn the ways of The Forsaken.

To the west you'll find a farm.  Humans infest the land like mold on a rotting corpse.  And worse yet, the Scarlet Crusade patrols nearby from their tower.  Teach those scum a lesson and steal 10 of their precious pumpkins.
Once you have 10, take them to Apothecary Johaan in Brill.
progress: Deathguard Simmer sent word that you were going to provide me with some much needed reagents. Were you able to gather 10 pumpkins yet, <name>?
completion: You have performed your bidding well, young <class>. You are proving yourself to be quite an asset to The Dark Lady's army.
